failure: Failure: This is a compatibility obstruction only. It does not establish the flexible-stability target, prove a vanishing theorem, or show that any specified group has such a central extension.
interface: Interface: The kernel is infinite cyclic and central; the total group has finite abelianization; cohomology has trivial real coefficients. The conclusion is a necessary compatibility condition, not a classification.

claims.title: A central infinite cyclic extension with finite abelianization forces nonzero real H2
